entities.summary: Stefan Borsch (b. 1947-01-19, Hagfors) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hagfors and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
